title: COTTI: Contrastive Training and Time-Aware Inference for Robust Industrial Recommendation under Promotional Drift
abstract: arXiv:2611.22597v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Promotional events shift traffic composition, purchase behavior, and the scale of conversion probabilities on different time horizons. We present \textbf{COTTI} (\textbf{CO}ntrastive \textbf{T}raining and \textbf{T}ime-aware \textbf{I}nference), an industrial recommendation framework that separates historical representation learning from event-time score adjustment. Cross-Period Contrastive Alignment (CPC) regularizes paired histories of the same user with adaptive consistency weights. Active Re-weighting (RW) controls the influence of promotional examples through historical-interest distance. Adaptive Boundary Alignment (ABA) combines stochastic prediction variability with a temporal event kernel to adjust logits while keeping predictor parameters fixed. We analyze the weighted objective and bound ABA-induced probability and ranking changes. On Fliggy data, COTTI attains an offline AUC of 0.8127, compared with 0.8101 for TEN and 0.8123

translated_title: COTTI：面向促销漂移下鲁棒工业推荐的对比训练与时间感知推理
translated_abstract: 促销事件会在不同的时间尺度上改变流量构成、购买行为以及转化概率的量级。我们提出了 COTTI（对比训练与时间感知推理），这是一个将历史表征学习与事件时刻分数调整相分离的工业推荐框架。其中，跨周期对比对齐（CPC）通过自适应一致性权重对同一用户的成对历史进行正则化；主动重加权（RW）通过历史兴趣距离控制促销样本的影响；自适应边界对齐（ABA）将随机预测变异性与时间事件核相结合，在保持预测器参数固定的情况下对 logits 进行调整。我们对加权目标进行了分析，并对 ABA 引起的概率和排序变化给出了理论上界。在飞猪数据上，COTTI 取得了 0.8127 的离线 AUC，相比之下 TEN 为 0.8101，另一对比方法为 0.8123。
tldr: COTTI 通过跨周期对比对齐、主动重加权和自适应边界对齐，将历史表征学习与促销事件时刻的分数调整相分离，在促销引起的分布漂移下实现鲁棒的工业推荐，并在飞猪数据上取得了更优的离线 AUC。
